exact_queue_script:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/chenzhe/work/hw
export PATH=/opt/anaconda3/bin:$PATH
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 HW_SKIP_ENV_CHECK=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=GPU-6b53c3c2-3071-5dfb-f306-2f2f142f8009
exec 9>analysis/results/round2_paper_four_baselines_v1/formal_20261111/newrf/queue.lock
flock -n 9
for outer in 0 1 2 3 4; do
  test "$(sha256sum code/round2/baseline_formal_20261111/newrf.py | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 8da7d760d2d056adab8824d48bfc763d9aae0d55012bd4bfb72166ed67844272
  test "$(sha256sum analysis/results/round2_paper_four_baselines_v1/formal_20261111/newrf/method_config.json | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 3582f1108c001814e506753785adb38478b821929d9e57b5647fdf987255beb3
  while ! test "$(nvidia-smi -i GPU-6b53c3c2-3071-5dfb-f306-2f2f142f8009 --query-gpu=memory.free --format=csv,noheader,nounits)" -ge 32768; do
    printf 'Waiting for 32GiB on allowed H1001 before outer%s at %s\n' "$outer" "$(date -Iseconds)"
    sleep 60
  done
  mkdir -p analysis/results/round2_paper_four_baselines_v1/formal_20261111/newrf/outer"$outer"
  printf 'Starting NeWRF outer%s on H1001 at %s\n' "$outer" "$(date -Iseconds)"
  code/tools/run_in_env.sh python -m round2.baseline_formal_20261111.newrf --mode run --outer "$outer" --gpu-uuid GPU-6b53c3c2-3071-5dfb-f306-2f2f142f8009 --config analysis/results/round2_paper_four_baselines_v1/formal_20261111/newrf/method_config.json >> analysis/results/round2_paper_four_baselines_v1/formal_20261111/newrf/outer"$outer"/run.log 2>&1
  printf 'Completed NeWRF outer%s at %s\n' "$outer" "$(date -Iseconds)"
done
